newsitem.title: USA: Toyota calls Republic suit without merit.
newsitem.headline: Toyota calls Republic suit without merit.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp's U.S. subsidiary said on Thursday that Republic Industries Inc's lawsuit against Toyota over the ownership of car dealerships is without merit.
"There is no merit to Republic's allegations. It is a desperate attempt to blame Toyota for Republic's own shortcomings," Toyota Motor Sales U.S.A vice president Yale Gieszl said in a statement.
Toyota claims that Republic intends to buy Toyota dealerships without having its performance evaluated.

Republic said earlier today that it filed a petition with the Tennessee Motor Vehicle Commission seeking declaratory judgment, injunctive relief, and civil and criminal penalties and sanctions against Toyota.
